Generated by Tools~/build_fonts.py from Tools~/lanbai_strings.py — edit that file, not this one. Lines are pre-broken (TMP word wrap OFF). Sizes are em heights in degrees of visual angle; place = [azimuth°, elevation°, distance m] in bus space.
display_rule: v4 (D-30, 2026-10-24; overrides bible §7.4-7): every player sees ONE language. Player key from the VRChat client language: zh* -> zh, ja -> ja, de -> de, anything else -> en. The original is shown when it is in the player's language (a de player reads the German originals, English otherwise); otherwise the translation into it (Chinese poems for ja = 書き下し). One block at the main-line size (CJK 2.2–2.4°, Latin 2.0–2.2° em; size_cjk / size_lat per poem), lines <= 28° (a language re-breaks its own lines: <key>_v4). Exception (D-30 #4): Tianwen is a picture in the sky: everyone sees the Han characters, a non-zh player also gets one 1.8° line of their language beneath (sub_line). Timing unchanged (§7.5, x1.3 kept). Zhuangzi: the shown language is mirrored, no caption. layout[player] per poem; block_table lists every block's size.

I would not be turned away!
From the deep sea I fell
The sky, so blue, so blue —
it would be just the same
At the far beginning of things,
who was there to tell of it?
When above and below had no form,
did Zhou dream he was a butterfly,
or does a butterfly dream it is Zhou?

IMFellEnglish-Roman.text: …all the rest had passed away like the images on the surface of a stream into which a stone has been cast, but, alas! without the after restoration of the latter!
Is broken—all that phantom-world so fair
Vanishes, and a thousand circlets spread,
And each mis-shape the other. Stay awhile,
Poor youth! who scarcely dar’st lift up thine eyes—
The stream will soon renew its smoothness, soon
The visions will return! And lo, he stays,
And soon the fragments dim of lovely forms
Come trembling back, unite, and now once more

head.text: OF THE FRAGMENT OF KUBLA KHAN.

prose.text: …all the rest had passed away like the images on the surface of a stream into which a stone has been cast, but, alas! without the after restoration of the latter!

lines: Is broken—all that phantom-world so fair
Vanishes, and a thousand circlets spread,
And each mis-shape the other. Stay awhile,
Poor youth! who scarcely dar’st lift up thine eyes—
The stream will soon renew its smoothness, soon

layout_model:
Lanbai / 蓝白 — the one place where every poem's TMP objects are laid out (art bible v2.1 §6·8, §7.2–7.5).

Both build_fonts.py (-> strings_all.json 'layout', build_report) and make_proofs.py (-> the proof sheets) call this,
so the numbers the Director reads and the pictures we looked at cannot disagree.

Model (what TMP 3.0 does for a world-space TextMeshPro, rich text off, no GSUB/GPOS, kern table only):
  * pen: advance + kern + tracking after every glyph; TMP subtracts the last glyph's tracking from the line's
    maxAdvance, so a centred line's box is [0, W] with W = sum(adv) + kern + tracking * (n - 1);
  * 1 em = 0.1 * fontSize world units at localScale 1  ->  fontSize = 10 * d * tan(size°);
  * every text object uses TextAlignmentOptions.Baseline (horizontal Center, first baseline on the transform).
Vertical em boxes: CJK = ideographic em box (BASE idtp 880 / ideo -120); Latin = ascender 0.72 / descender -0.26.
Elevations are degrees of visual angle, positive up; a parent at (az, el_anchor, d) faces the head and children sit
at local y = d * tan(el - el_anchor), local x = offset_em * em_m.
zhuangzi_rule:
§6·8 mirror treatment, v4 of this kit (D-30: each player sees ONE language; bible v2.1: only L1 and L3):
       * the player's text is mirrored (the original for zh players, 書き下し for ja, English for everyone else).
         Column (from the top): L1, L3', | horizon |, L3, L1'. The line whose upright copy is BELOW the horizon
         (L3, read looking down) sits next to the horizon, so the typesetting flips exactly at "其视下也，亦若是则已矣";
         L1 and its mirror frame the column. A segment may have several lines (ja / en); the column keeps the
         language's own pitch (1.6 em CJK, 1.35 em Latin) everywhere, the horizon in the middle of the central gap:
         one evenly spaced block that reflects onto itself;
       * no caption slot any more (v3 put the translation under the column);
       * everything leaves together at 989.0 for 4 s, in step with the F12 sun-line collapse: objects above the
         horizon drift up, objects below drift down (each upright / mirror pair separates, the reflection stays exact).
    t_now (s after L1): if given, only objects visible at that moment are returned (for the time strip).

colour_rule:
Lanbai / 蓝白 — poem and scrim colours: bible SCREEN TARGET -> what Unity must be FILLED with (verify round 2, B.1).

Bible law 1: every hex in §7.5 / §7.2 is a screen target (what a screenshot reads), not a value to type in.
A poem is unlit and is graded by the PPv2 grade live while it is on screen (Neutral tonemap, postExposure, white
balance, contrast, lift / gamma / gain, saturation), and TMP 3.0.6 applies no colour-space conversion to vertex
colours (TMP_SDF.shader: faceColor.rgb *= input.color.rgb). So:
  * TMP Vertex Color = WHITE, carrying only the alpha (0.90; scene 6d 1.00; scene 11 0.80; mirror 0.45; x the fade);
  * the colour goes on the poem's own material (preset) as the HDR _FaceColor = the scene-linear FILL solved here;
  * scrims: SpriteRenderer.color = (1, 1, 1, alpha); the colour is the Sprites/Default material's _Color = the fill.
The fill is solved with the bible's own look simulator (calib_final.solve; vendored in Tools~/colour_sim so the kit
works outside the art tree, verify r3 m2) under the grade that is LIVE while the poem is read. Two poems are read
during a PPv2 volume blend (bible §1.4: param = lerp(lower, higher, weight)):
  * 李白 I (71.80-86.80): S3 at weight ~0.3 over S2 (§6·3: 0 -> 0.3 over 39.10-79.10, smoothstep);
  * 里尔克 (137.30-150.30): S4 rising over S3 (§6·4 "3 -> 4": 0 -> 1 over 133.80-163.80, smoothstep);
they are solved at the blend weight of mid-hold, and the reading over the whole hold is reported.
    fill_hdr "#RRGGBB @ +n"  = Unity HDR colour picker: hex + Intensity n (linear x 2^n), like calib_final.md §B.
    fill_linear [r, g, b]    = the value the shader receives (Material.SetColor(name, linear.gamma) in a Linear project).
Engine cross-check: if the Grading kit (deliver2/Grading) is next to this kit, every fill is also run through its
engine-faithful PPv2 model with its engine-solved grades (Grading verify B1), and the code difference is reported.
